body:
Hi!  My suggestion is to change the term name to "chronic myeloid leukemia" as it is the preferred and most common name, with "Chronic Myelogenous Leukemia" being an older synonym;   I understand that the full name "Chronic Myelogenous Leukemia, BCR-ABL1 positive" is more precise because CML is defined by the presence of the BCR-ABL1 gene, distinguishing it from rare CML-like disorders, and should be kept as a synonym. 

Chronic myeloid leukemia is the standard term used by the National Cancer Institute, and National Institutes of Health, and major health organizations like the American Cancer Society,
Please see: 
https://www.cancer.gov/types/leukemia/patient/cml-treatment-pdq
https://medlineplus.gov/genetics/condition/chronic-myeloid-leukemia/#synonyms
https://www.cancer.org/cancer/types/chronic-myeloid-leukemia/about/what-is-cml.html

Thank you,  Gioconda Alyea
title: chronic myelogenous leukemia, BCR-ABL1 positive
